depiction_rules.notes: D027 divine identity and stanza-specific anatomy; the Guruvayurappan sheet is an identity cue only.

visual_bible.face: serene mature divine face, proportionate and consistent with approved Guruvayurappan identity cues
visual_bible.skin: established deep muted indigo-blue, matte mineral pigment
visual_bible.clothing: warm cream and painted ochre with deep maroon accents; restrained sacred ornament
visual_bible.anatomy: four attached arms only where the scene uses the four-armed divine form; stanza 11 exactly two arms/hands; no scene may accumulate extra limbs
visual_bible.attributes: conch, discus, mace, lotus only when a scene needs iconographic attributes; do not make them obscure narrative hand actions
visual_bible.style: flat matte mural; identity reference does not authorize glossy rendering

anatomy_contract.arms: four in S002–S004 and S009; exactly two in S011
anatomy_contract.rule: scene-specific arm count; S011 has both hands gripping the same continuous Vasuki

never: no readable text or metallic shine
identity_scope: D027 scene continuity only; not an approved character master
